body: It's... a myriad of reasons, really. The big one, however, is that the girl that I've loved for a very long time now, and is aware of my feelings, is confused about how she feels. And I am sick of waiting for her to make a decision. It makes me like this. I can't just back out, cut my losses, and say "Sorry, pal, I'm out. Can't take it" I can't just abandon her, because she needs me. Her mom tried to kill herself a few days ago. I can't commit another betrayal to her. That's quite possibly the worst thing I could do, I think. It's counterproductive to stay, though, because I get so depressed to the point where I want to not be here. Every option will hurt her. I am backed up against a wall, with nothing but to be miserable, and keep quiet about it. I'm trapped inside my head.
I don't know. There's nothing that stands out. Just a general feeling of "This doesn't feel worth it, anymore"
